criteria.criterion_verbatim: - Type a synthetic password and confirm its bytes never appear in captured test logs.
criteria.disposition: Verified in the actual selected native fixture, within current-process stdout/stderr capture scope.
evidence: The fixture inserts four fixed public synthetic probes through actual UIKit UIKeyInput; real EditingChanged delivery invokes the exact originating sample callbacks.
The passed native method asserts exact byte absence independently in bounded stdout and stderr captures after original descriptors restore.

Nine distinct actual native capture controls cover both real sinks, public positive controls, original descriptor identities and flags, throwable identity, nesting/oversize refusal, and independently attempted controlled cleanup.
An independent scan finds no exact probe bytes in the original job log or either XML. Raw private captures and all-system/unified logs are not uploaded.

criteria.disposition: Verified by fixed-source prevention assertion and exact source applicability; accepted qualification reused, not replayed.

All seven qualified additions and five full postimages match. The sixth postimage differs only in an unrelated #50/IO-013 scope literal, with #99 code, filter and validators unchanged.
